title: Legacy PIN credential pk1.<phone>.<pin> is guessable and still accepted; enables direct GoTrue password-grant brute force bypassing app lockout
steps: Code review: lib/auth/pinCore.js legacyPinSecret + runPinLogin (allowLegacy !== false). Any account whose password was never upgraded can be tried at POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with password pk1.91XXXXXXXXXX.NNNN
expected: Legacy secrets removed/rotated; legacy fallback off
actual: Legacy fallback on by default; only GoTrue per-IP sign-in limit (10/5 min) protects those accounts
environment: Local dev: next dev on localhost:3000 (ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=1), Supabase local 127.0.0.1:54321, 10 Nov 2026
